notes.title: Deck of Defense 2.0! Medieval Era!!
notes.notes: Wow, after a great couple weeks of playtesting we are transitioning into the demo stage of the game. This update comes with MANY improvements as well as the brand new medieval era. I hope you all enjoy very much!

notes.title: Volcano Rework + new Heal Card
notes.notes: The volcano BADLY needed a rework, however as I am writing this patch I am realizing I did not change the description of the card. Just know that now it damages all enemies within a range with a flame. The heal card completely heals any object on the board. Enjoy!

notes.title: Added touch movement, bug fixes - thanks to playtesters bred_manguyboy & Nick
notes.notes: I was able to implement some touch controls as well as patch some bugs that were desperately calling to be fixed. I also added the heal card which can heal a tower to full health - find it in the utility packs!

notes.title: Time Controls Update & Additional Quality of Life Changes
notes.notes: I updated the time controls menu as well as added a few features that will help your experience with the game. There was also a minor pack cost re balancing. Side note - obelisk was removed in favor of a new healing card yet to be added. Enjoy!

notes.title: Fixing the game after I broke
Balance patch to make packs cheaper
Added Coconut Tree Tower - Ancient Era Card
notes.notes: The idea of the Coconut Tree came from the original stone wheel roller where the projectile rolls through enemies. This tower however shoots coconuts down their select row. I think you'll find it interesting and quite powerful![url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45093895/9f2bd748c92ef5148bcb1569f6336cfbb02c46fa.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45093895/3708e051bd85dcb3172e40563572a6f973307b1f.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Drum Patch
notes.notes: The drum was not working past the 8th row so if you upgraded your defense length far enough you encountered this issue. Now fixed.

notes.title: Day 0 Patch - Thank you to bred_manguyboy, Alaric, Rizzler
notes.notes: Thank you to the players listed above for filling out the bug report form. Their input went into helping the game with bug issues and resolving other problems future players might have otherwise experienced. This has been an exhausting day 0 but I am happy to say that I think I have fixed most of the big issues. Enjoy!

notes.title: Fixed Exit button bug
notes.notes: There was a bug that broke the exit button while you were playing a card at the same time of losing, now fixed.

notes.title: JULY PLAYTEST OPEN NOW!
notes.notes: Thanks for joining Deck of Defenses July play testing group. This version is extremely early and is still missing many features such as additional sound & music. Fill out the associated forms for suggestions and bugs. Thank you!
